Name: Ammihud
Summary: Ammihud is named in Numbers as the father of Elishama the prince of Ephraim, and of Shemuel and Pedahel among the men who divided the land.
KeyStory: Ammihud's sons served Israel in the wilderness and in the dividing of Canaan.
RelatedPeople: Elishama, Son of Ammihud; Shemuel, Son of Ammihud; Pedahel, Son of Ammihud; Moses
LifeLesson: A father's legacy is measured in the service of his children.
